STANZA I
Questions and doubts be heard no more
Questions and doubts be heard no more;
Let Christ and joy be all our theme;
His Spirit seals his gospel sure,
To every soul that trusts in him.
Where Watts found it
Watts printed the hymn under 1 John 5:10. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son. 1 JOHN 5:10 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ 1 JOHN 5
Jesus, thy witness speaks within: The mercy which thy words reveal Refines the heart from sense and sin, And stamps its own celestial seal. STANZA II
